title: uuencoding-multi PartCollection: is_complete() false-positive documented but not tested for single-element no-total case
description: uuencoding-multi/src/collection.rs: the is_complete() and new() docs warn that adding a single part to a no-total PartCollection immediately makes is_complete() return true (total is inferred as 1). This is a known footgun documented in two places. However there is no test exercising this false-positive case — only a test for is_complete_false_when_total_unknown (empty collection, no total). Adding a test that adds exactly part 1 to a no-total collection and asserts is_complete() == true would pin the behavior as intentional and prevent someone from 'fixing' it in a way that breaks the documented invariant.
